name: ua-nested-lists
note: The UA stylesheet's nested-list rules authored directly with :is() — Blink's :is(dl, ol, ul) :is(ol, ul) margin reset, :is(ol, ul) ul circle markers, and :is(ol, ul) :is(ol, ul) ul square markers — replacing the hand-expanded descendant-pair rules now that the matcher supports :is(). A two-level ul nesting and an ol-in-ol prove list-style-type, margins, and marker geometry against Chrome.
